children: Flock Safety, the firm that has come under pressure from alleged abuse of its cameras, is evaluating selling itself.

The company has had preliminary discussions with outside advisers, according to a Semafor report  on Wednesday, which cited people familiar with the matter. No decision has been made on whether to go forward with a sales process.
A Flock spokesperson declined to comment to Semafor.
Flock's technology and network could appeal to rivals such as taser-maker Axon Enterprise
, which operates a network of automated license-plate readers, or Motorola Solutions
, another competitor, according to the report.
Flock was valued at $8.3 billion in a $500 million Series H funding round, backed by Andreessen Horowitz and Tiger Global, Fortune reported earlier this year. Axon
